notes.title: The First Public Playtest of A Scarlet Way!
notes.content:
Hello, players!
We’re launching our first public playtest on Steam, and anyone can join!
You can already request access on the game’s main Steam page.



Playtest starts: July 15, 2025
Playtest ends: July 31, 2025

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101843/22df3aa07f2227d054113290df1bd62294ec9587.png"]
Goals of the playtest:
Fine-tune the combat system to make it as satisfying and fun as possible — while keeping it challenging

Gather feedback on control feel and responsiveness

Understand how you experience the overall gameplay dynamics
What’s not ready yet:
All visual elements (environment, UI, animations) and sound effects are temporary and do not reflect the final quality

Performance optimization is still in progress

Game balance is not final
Why you should join:
You’ll have a chance to directly influence the game’s development

Your feedback will help us improve the experience and shape the game’s direction

You'll receive a unique reward at launch (we won’t spoil what it is yet — mostly because we haven’t decided either 😄)

We welcome everyone — see you in the playtest!

notes.title: Steam Page Update
notes.content:
Hey, players!

We’ve updated our Steam page to make it clearer what Untold Tales: A Scarlet Way is all about — both through the description and visuals.

But this is just the beginning. We’re actively working on a public demo and will continue improving the page with new screenshots and videos.
